items.title: William Russell Interview, 1976-02-16
items.q: Nichols is some teacher. I think at a Pennsylvania college... I never did meet Ferguson

ctx.x: Oh, Red Nichols. Now, this to me is very interesting, because if Otis Ferguson was interested in Bix, why didn't he write the chapter on Bix? But that's... Let's see. Who wrote the chapter on Bix? Edwards. Edward J. Nichols. Nichols. Who I don't know who he...
Nichols writes the Bix chapter and...
Yeah. He's not related to Red Nichols, no. No. No, no. You don't know anything about either Ferguson or Nichols?
